title: How Listings Are Reviewed
content:
How Listings Are Reviewed

Aerogela is an editorial directory. We review listings using publicly available information and selected first-party submissions to improve directory quality, reduce obvious errors, and help users understand the current confidence level of each profile.

Typical review inputs

  • Official company or institution websites
  • Public product, application, or service pages
  • Public contact and location details
  • Claim requests and submit-listing information provided through Aerogela workflows
  • Internal editorial classification of category, main products, and application fields

What we usually check

  • Whether the organization appears active and relevant to the aerogel ecosystem
  • Whether the website and public identity match the listing title
  • Whether the category, location, and core offering look directionally correct
  • Whether the listing needs correction, consolidation, or removal

Review statuses

Reviewed

A Reviewed listing has been checked by Aerogela using editorial review of public information. This means the profile has received a manual quality pass, but it does not mean the business has been independently certified by a third-party authority.

Verified

A Verified listing has stronger confirmation than a standard reviewed profile. In practice this may include a successful claim flow, direct confirmation from the representative, or other higher-confidence validation signals available to the directory.

What review does not guarantee

  • Commercial quality, technical suitability, or pricing competitiveness
  • Regulatory, safety, export-control, or procurement compliance
  • That all information will remain current after publication

Requesting an update

If you represent a listed company and would like to improve or correct a profile, use one of these workflows:

  • Claim Listing
  • Submit a Listing
  • Request Quote / Contact Supplier for communication support
